resolved.title: map 函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]map[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The built-in functions [b]map [/b]and [b]filter [/b]are very useful higher-order functions that operate on lists (or similar objects called [b]iterables[/b]). 
The function [b]map[/b] takes a function and an iterable as arguments, and returns a new iterable with the function applied to each argument.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="385"]def add_five(x):
  return x + 5

nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]
result = list([b]map[/b](add_five, nums))
print(result)[/code]
We could have achieved the same result more easily by using [b]lambda [/b]syntax.[code format="py" codeId="386"]nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]

result = list(map([b]lambda x: x+5[/b], nums))
print(result)[/code]
[note]To convert the result into a list, we used [b]list [/b]explicitly.[/note]

content.text:
内置函数**map**和**filter**是非常有用的高阶函数，可以对列表（或称为**可迭代**的对象）进行操作。

函数**map**接收一个函数和一个迭代器作为参数，并返回一个新的迭代器，该函数应用于可迭代的元素。

**例子：**
content.text_html:
The built-in functions **map **and **filter **are very useful higher-order functions that operate on lists (or similar objects called iterables). The function map takes a function and an iterable as arguments, and returns a new iterable with the function applied to each argument.

Example:

内置函数map 和filter 是非常有用的高阶函数，可以对列表（或称为iterables的类似对象）进行操作。 函数map接收一个函数和一个迭代器作为参数，并返回一个新的迭代器，该函数应用于每个参数。

例子：

content.content:
def add_five(x):
    return x + 5

nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]
# 对列表nums 的每个元素 +5
result = list(map(add_five, nums))
print(result)

content.text: 可以通过使用**lambda**语法更简洁地实现的功能。
content.text_html:
We could have achieved the same result more easily by using **lambda **syntax.

我们可以通过使用**lambda **语法更容易地实现同样的结果。

content.content:
nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]

# map 中函数变为lambda 函数
result = list(map(lambda x: x+5, nums))
print(result)

content.text: 为了将结果转换成一个列表，我们明确地使用了**list**转换。
content.text_html:
To convert the result into a list, we used **list **explicitly.

为了将结果转换成一个列表，我们明确地使用了**list **。

resolved.title: 工资单
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个工资单`salaries`，并输入奖金`bonus`。

请将所有的工资都增加到相应的奖金，并输出工资单。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]map[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You work on a payroll program.
Given a [b]list[/b] of salaries, you need to take the [b]bonus[/b] everybody is getting as input and increase all the salaries by that amount.
Output the resulting list.
[note]You can use the [b]map[/b]() function to increase all the values of the list.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
- 可以使用**map**()函数将列表中每个元素增加相应的数值。
- 输出结果列表。

code_templates.template:
salaries = [2000, 1800, 3100, 4400, 1500] # 工资

code_templates.solution_code:
salaries = [2000, 1800, 3100, 4400, 1500] # 工资
bonus = int(input())  # 奖金

def add_bouns(x):
    return x + bonus

salaries = list(map(add_bouns, salaries))

print(salaries)

resolved.title: filter 函数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]filter[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The function [b]filter[/b] filters an iterable by leaving only the items that match a condition (also called a [b]predicate[/b]).

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="5054"]nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]
res = list([b]filter[/b](lambda x: x%2==0, nums))
print(res)[/code]
[note]Like [b]map[/b], the result has to be explicitly converted to a list if you want to print it.[/note]

The function [b]filter[/b] filters an iterable by leaving only the items that match a condition (also called a [b]predicate[/b]).

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="5054"]nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]

content.text:
函数**filter**过滤一个可迭代项，只留下符合条件的数据项。

**例子：**
content.text_html:
The function filter filters an iterable by leaving only the items that match a condition (also called a predicate).

Example:

函数filter通过只留下符合条件（也称为**谓词）的项目来过滤一个可迭代项。

例子：

content.content:
nums = [11, 22, 33, 44, 55]
# 相当于保留偶数
res = list(filter(lambda x: x%2==0, nums))
print(res)

content.text: 和**map**一样，如果你想打印它，结果必须明确地转换为一个列表。
content.text_html:
Like map, the result has to be explicitly converted to a list if you want to print it.

和map一样，如果你想打印它，结果必须明确地转换为一个列表。
